title: Getting started
summary: Set up a local Velclaw workspace from the verified repository configuration and learn how the docs are organized.

sections.heading: Create a workspace
body: The source repository is a private Next.js application. Its lockfile is pnpm v9; package.json defines the project scripts used below.

examples.code:
git clone https://github.com/Velclaw/Velclaw.git
cd Velclaw
corepack enable
pnpm install
pnpm dev

sections.heading: Validate the project
body: The verified package scripts include build, lint, and type-check. The repository CI currently tests Node.js 18.x, 20.x, and 22.x.

examples.code:
pnpm build
pnpm lint
pnpm type-check

sections.heading: Choose an article
body: Use the sidebar to browse the documentation. Each article is loaded as a separate static JSON document.

sections.heading: Share a link
body: Routes use the URL hash by default. The doc query parameter is also supported for static hosting.
